items.text: Your Platforms, Connected to Business Central
Burq connects Dynamics 365 Business Central to your ecommerce, marketplace, CRM, and shipping platforms — syncing orders, inventory, and financials in real time, without custom development.
Orders, inventory, and customer records copied between systems by hand. Every keystroke is a potential error. Every hour spent is overhead.
Stock levels in Business Central and your storefronts fall out of sync. Overselling follows. Customer complaints follow that.
Finance teams spending days reconciling what should already match. The gap between your ERP and your sales channels shows up in every close.
One integration platform. Every platform you run.

Burq connects Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central to your entire commercial ecosystem — ecommerce storefronts, marketplaces, CRM, and 3PL — through pre-built, maintained connectors. Orders flow in. Inventory flows out. Nothing requires a developer to keep it running.
Burq scopes and builds integrations for platforms not listed here.
Platform → BC. Sales orders created automatically in Business Central the moment they're placed on any connected platform.
BC → All platforms. Stock levels updated across every connected storefront and marketplace simultaneously when changed in Business Central.
BC → Platform. SKUs, variants, and pricing pushed from Business Central as the single source of truth.
Platform ↔ BC. New customer records created and matched — no duplicates, no manual entry.
BC → CRM/Platform. Invoice status visible to sales and finance without switching systems.
BC → Platform. Price lists, tier pricing, and promotions maintained in Business Central, reflected on your storefronts.
Shipping ↔ BC. Shipment records, tracking numbers, and delivery confirmations sync across every channel.
BC → Platform. Confirmed, shipped, and cancelled status updates reach the originating storefront in real time.
Built Differently from Generic Integration Tools
Every connector is built and maintained by Burq's engineering team. When Shopify or Amazon updates their API, Burq handles it. Your integration keeps running.
Operations teams manage sync rules, field mapping, and error handling through a UI — not a terminal. Changes take minutes, not a support ticket.
Data moves as events happen. Every sync is logged. Failed records retry automatically and surface in your dashboard with alerts.
Burq is a Folio3 product. Folio3 is a Microsoft Gold Partner with over 15 years of Business Central implementation experience.
WooCommerce + Business Central. Replaced a manual sync process between WooCommerce and Business Central with Burq's real-time integration — eliminating data lag and reconciliation overhead.
Amazon + Business Central. Connected Amazon Seller Central to Business Central — giving the team a single view of orders, inventory, and customer data without adding headcount.

Channel Advisor + Business Central. Integrated Channel Advisor with Business Central for a global licensed apparel business — real-time visibility across marketplace and ERP for operations and finance.
Connect Business Central to your platforms

Tell us which platforms you're running. We'll walk you through how Burq connects them — what syncs, how errors are handled, and what your go-live timeline looks like. Pre-built connectors. Real-time sync. Live in weeks, not months.
